What to Expect Medical Review Board & Editorial Policies

Who We Are

What to Expect is the world’s best-known, most trusted pregnancy and parenting brand, helping every parent know what to expect, every step of the way. What to Expect’s app and website are produced by What to Expect’s founder, Heidi Murkoff, alongside a team of journalists, editors, physicians and other pregnancy and parenting health experts.

Editorial Policies

References, sources and citations: What to Expect adheres to the highest standards of journalistic integrity, with sourcing guidelines relying only on peer-reviewed medical journals, academic institutions, government agencies and highly respected medical organizations such as the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG), the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) as primary sources of information. You can see the sources we use in the “view sources” field at the bottom of every health article, along with the last reviewed date at the top.

Editorial independence: What to Expect’s editorial team maintains complete editorial independence and control over content. No unrelated partners or sponsors are permitted to change content or influence the selection of content (see Advertising Policy). Additionally, What to Expect participates in affiliate marketing programs, but this does not impact what products we choose to cover. We maintain a strict product review policy, and commissions earned simply help support all the work we do.

Contributors: What to Expect works with writers who specialize in creating content about pregnancy-, parenting- and health-related topics. All contributors are carefully vetted for their subject matter expertise, and are provided additional training in sourcing, researching and reporting.

Content updates: What to Expect adheres to a content maintenance schedule. Additionally, our editors update articles when new information becomes available. Articles may be updated when there are new clinical guidelines, changes in standards of care, new practice recommendations or product recalls. What to Expect editors also review articles when readers alert us about potential issues with our content (contact us at edit@whattoexpect.com).

Links to other sites: What to Expect articles sometimes contain links to other websites. We neither control nor endorse these linked sites, nor does the company review or approve the content that appears on them. What to Expect is not responsible for the legality, accuracy or inappropriate nature of any content, advertising, products or other materials on or available from any linked sites.

Fact-Check and Medical Review Policy

What to Expect When You’re Expecting, 5th edition, and What to Expect Before You’re Expecting, 2nd edition, have been medically reviewed by Charles J. Lockwood, M.D., Professor of Obstetrics & Gynecology and Public Health, and Dean of the University of South Florida’s Morsani College of Medicine. What to Expect the First Year, 3rd edition, has been medically reviewed by Mark D. Widome, M.D., M.P.H., Professor of Pediatrics at Penn State Hershey Children’s Hospital.

Meet What to Expect Founder Heidi Murkoff

Heidi Murkoff is the creator of What to Expect, the world’s best-known, most trusted pregnancy and parenting brand. She is also the founder of WhatToExpect.com and the What to Expect Foundation.

Meet the What to Expect Medical Review Board

Dr. Rebecca Amaru is a board-certified OB/GYN practicing in New York City.

Dr. Amaru completed her OB/GYN residency at Mount Sinai Hospital and received her M.D. from the Mount Sinai School of Medicine, both in New York City.

She is currently in private practice at Brasner, Blumberg & Amaru in Manhattan.

Board certification

Dr. Amaru is board-certified with the American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology, and is a Fellow of the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Amaru is affiliated with Mount Sinai Hospital in New York City.

Other relevant positions

Dr. Amaru is an assistant clinical professor in the OB/GYN Department at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai. Each year, she serves as preceptor for a group of third-year medical students during their clerkship in OB/GYN, and teaches the first-year medical students how to take a gynecologic history in their "Art and Science of Medicine" course.

Her practice interests include low- and moderate-risk obstetrics, breastfeeding support, adolescent gynecology, sexual and psychosocial health throughout womens' lifespans.

Dr. Amaru lives with her husband and four daughters in White Plains, New York.

Awards

Dr. Amaru has been a Castle Connolly Top Doctor since 2017 and was an Exceptional Women in Medicine awardee in 2019 and 2020.

Dr. Annie Andrews is a board-certified pediatrician and a Clinical Professor of Pediatrics at George Washington School of Medicine.

Experience

Dr. Andrews has a B.S. degree in pre-medicine from the University of Dayton. She earned her M.D. from University of Cincinnati College of Medicine and completed her residency in pediatrics at Cincinnati Children's Hospital.

Board certifications

Dr. Andrews is board-certified by the American Board of Pediatrics.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Andrews is affiliated with Children's National Medical Center in Washington, D.C..

Other relevant positions

Dr. Andrews is a faculty member at George Washington School of Medicine and a fellow of the American Academy of Pediatrics (FAAP). She is a Senior Advisor at Everytown for Gun Safety and Moms Demand Action. She is the Founder and CEO of Their Future. Our Vote. and Their Future PAC.

Publications

Dr. Andrews has published nearly 100 peer-reviewed publications in medical journals ranging in focus from asthma to pediatric firearm injuries.

Awards

Dr. Andrews has received multiple awards from the AAP and the American Medical Association for her work in child advocacy.

Dr. Allison Bloom is a board-certified OB/GYN and board-eligible reproductive endocrinology and infertility specialist practicing at Main Line Fertility in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

Dr. Bloom graduated from the University of Massachusetts with a Bachelor of Science before earning her Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (D.O.) and Masters in Public Health (M.P.H.) from Nova Southeastern University College of Osteopathic Medicine in Fort Lauderdale, Florida.

She then completed her residency in Obstetrics and Gynecology at Drexel University College of Medicine/Hahnemann University Hospital in Philadelphia as well as a fellowship in Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility with Main Line Fertility/Drexel University College of Medicine.

Board certifications

Dr. Bloom is board-certified by the American College of Obstetrics and Gynecology.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Bloom is affiliated with Lankenau Medical Center, Bryn Mawr Hospital, Paoli Hospital and Chester County Hospital.

Other relevant positions

Dr. Bloom is a member of the clinical faculty at Lankenau Hospital and a board member of the Philadelphia Area Reproductive Endocrine Society.

Dr. Bloom is also affiliated with the American Society for Reproductive Medicine (ASRM), Gay and Lesbian Medical Association, American Osteopathic Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology (AOBOG), American Osteopathic Association (AOA) and American Medical Association (AMA).

Awards

Dr. Bloom has received a number of awards, including:

Health Care Hero Award, Penn Medicine

Seymour Stein Memorial Resident/Fellow Annual Research Award, three-time recipient

Educational Chief Resident, Obstetrics and Gynecology, Drexel University College of Medicine

Medical Student Teaching Award Recipient, Drexel University College of Medicine, two-time recipient

Resident CREOG Exam Achievement Award, four-time recipient

Phi Sigma Alpha, National Osteopathic Scholastic Society inductee

Sigma Sigma Phi, National Honorary Service Fraternity, President

Matthew Terry Scholarship recipient for scholastic excellence, service, empathy and congeniality

M.D., F.A.C.O.G.

Dr. Jennifer Butt is a board-certified OB/GYN practicing in New York City.

Dr. Butt was part of the B.A./M.D. program at Rutgers University in New Brunswick, New Jersey— receiving her B.A. in Biological Studies and M.D. from the Rutgers Robert Wood Johnson Medical School. She completed her residency in obstetrics and gynecology at Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital.

She currently sees patients at her own private practice, Upper East Side OB/GYN, located in Manhattan.

Board certification

Dr. Butt is board-certified with the American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology, and is a Fellow of the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Butt is affiliated with Lenox Hill Hospital in New York City.

Other relevant positions

Inspired to start her own business and deliver top-quality personalized care to her patients, Dr. Butt founded the practice Upper East Side OB/GYN in 2018.

She lives with her husband and son in downtown Manhattan.

Dr. Carson is recognized internationally as an educator and researcher regarding medical disorders in pregnancy. He is the director of research at an internal medicine residency and works in private practice in Manasquan, New Jersey.

A Philadelphia native, Dr. Carson earned his medical degree from Temple University after receiving his bachelor’s degree from Lafayette College. He did his internal medicine residency at Brown University/Rhode Island Hospital, where he was selected to serve as chief medical resident. He completed a fellowship in obstetric and consultative medicine at Women & Infants Hospital of Rhode Island at Brown University.

Dr. Carson and his wife Miriam, a labor and delivery nurse, live in Long Branch, New Jersey, and have two adult children.

Board certifications

Dr. Carson has been board-certified with the American Board of Internal Medicine since 1995, and is a Fellow of the American College of Physicians.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Carson is affiliated with Jersey Shore University Medical Center in Neptune, New Jersey, and Community Medical Center in Toms River, New Jersey.

Other relevant positions

He is a professor of medicine and obstetrics/gynecology at the Hackensack Meridian School of Medicine, and is on the faculty for a National OB/GYN Board Review Course.

Dr. Carson is the a past president of the North American Society of Obstetric Medicine, a published researcher focusing on women's health and gestational diabetes, and a co-editor of Sex and Gender-Based Women's Health: A Practical Guide for Primary Care.

Awards

Dr. Carson received the Teaching Award in the Department of Obstetrics & Gynecology at Brown University. He is the recepient of the Louis F. Albright Award for Excellence in Clinical Education at the Internal Medicine Residency Program of Jersey Shore University Medical Center in Neptune, New Jersey. Dr. Carson is also a Monmouth County, New Jersey, Top Doctor.

Miriam Carson is a certified registered nurse who earned her Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) from the University of Pennsylvania. She works as a labor and delivery and outpatient obstetrics nurse at University Medical Centers.

Carson and her husband Michael, an internal medicine physician who specializes in the care of pregnant women with medical issues, live in Long Branch, New Jersey, and have two adult children.

Carson works in the labor and delivery unit and with underserved patients at the outpatient OB/GYN clinic at Riverview Medical Center Red Bank, New Jersey. She is also the assistant manager in a postpartum unit.

Board certifications

Carson is certified through the National Certification Corporation in Inpatient Obstetrics.

Hospital affiliations

Carson is affiliated with Pennsylvania Hospital in Philadelphia; Women & Infants Hospital of Rhode Island; Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital in New Brunswick, New Jersey; and Riverview Medical Center in Red Bank, New Jersey.

Other relevant positions

Carson is a published author in the Journal of Perinatal Education and participates in a nursing help line for new moms.

Awards

Carson was recognized as an Outstanding Nurse Educator by the OB/GYN Residency Program at Rutgers/Robert Wood Johnson University Medical Center in New Brunswick, New Jersey.

D.N.P., C.L.C., C.P.S.T.

Suzanne Chan is a board-certified pediatric nurse practitioner working in the Infant Cardiac NICU at NewYork-Presbyterian Morgan Stanley Children's Hospital in New York City. In addition to her expertise in labor and delivery, Chan is also a certified lactation counselor (CLC) and a Certified Passenger Safety Technician (CPST).

Chan has not only earned a Bachelor of Science and Master of Science in Nursing, but also a Doctorate of Nursing Practice from Columbia University in New York City.

Board certification

Chan is board certified by the Pediatric Nursing Certification Board.

Hospital affiliation

Chan is affiliated with NewYork-Presbyterian Morgan Stanley Children's Hospital in New York City.

Other relevant positions

Chan is a member of the American Nurses Association (ANA), the National Association of Pediatric Nurse Practitioners (NAPNAP), the American Association of Nurse Practitioners (AANP), and the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP).

She lives in New York with her husband, three children, and their beloved dog.

Kristin Cohen, DNP, CNM, WHNP-BC, is a certified nurse midwife and a board certified women’s health nurse practitioner.

As a midwife and nurse practitioner, Cohen specializes in providing evidence-based, patient-centered care that emphasizes health promotion, shared-decision making, and limiting intervention in natural physiologic processes.

Experience

Cohen currently practices in New Jersey, where she cares for people during labor and birth, as well as throughout pregnancy and the postpartum period.

She also provides gynecological care to people of all ages, including annual exams, health screenings, and contraceptive management.

Before becoming an advanced practice nurse, Cohen worked for many years as a labor and delivery nurse, as well as in home care and infection prevention.

Education

Cohen received her Doctor of Nursing Practice degree from Rutgers University. She holds a B.S. in biology from University of Mary Washington and a B.S. in nursing from the University of Maryland-Baltimore.

Dr. Lauren Crosby is a pediatrician in Beverly Hills, California, and a nationally-recognized parenting expert.

After graduating from Smith College and the UCLA School of Medicine, Dr. Crosby trained at Cedars-Sinai Medical Center, where she served as Chief Resident.

She is currently in private practice at La Peer Pediatrics in Beverly Hills.

Board certifications

Dr. Crosby is board-certified by the American Board of Pediatrics and is a Fellow of the American Academy of Pediatrics.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Crosby is an attending physician at Cedars-Sinai Medical Center in Los Angeles.

Other relevant positions

Dr. Crosby is a member of the American Academy of Pediatrics Council on Communications in Media and an official spokeswoman for the American Academy of Pediatrics.

She is a pediatric consultant and medical correspondent for television news, is on the Advisory Board of the Make-A-Wish Foundation, and is a founding member of Hope in A Suitcase.

Dr. Crosby is also the mother of two sons.

Dr. Marty Ellington is a board-certified pediatrician and neonatologist practicing at Lenox Hill Hospital in New York City. He currently serves as Chairman of Pediatrics and Director of Newborn Services at Lenox Hill Hospital. Dr. Ellington received an M.D. as well as an M.P.H. from the University of Michigan in Ann Arbor.

Dr. Ellington completed his residency at UCSF Department of Pediatrics in San Francisco, California, and a fellowship in newborn medicine at Boston Children’s Hospital and Harvard Medical School.

Dr. Ellington has been selected as among the best neonatologists in New York City by the New York Times and New York magazine for numerous years.

Board certifications

Dr. Ellington is board-certified by the American Board of Pediatrics.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Ellington is affiliated with Lenox Hill Hospital in New York City.

Other relevant positions

Dr. Ellington is Chairman of Pediatrics and Chairman of the Credentials Committees at Lenox Hill Hospital. He is also an assistant professor at the Donald and Barbara Zucker School of Medicine at Hofstra/Northwell in Hempstead, New York.

Aimee Eyvazzadeh, M.D., M.P.H., also known as the "egg whisperer," is an OB/GYN and a fertility specialist in San Ramon, California. She's been practicing medicine for more than 22 years.

Dr. Aimee graduated from the UCLA School of Medicine and did her residency in Obstetrics & Gynecology at Harvard Medical School. She also completed a fellowship in Reproductive Endocrinology & Infertility and holds a Masters in Public Health Management and Policy from the University of Michigan.

Board certifications

Dr. Aimee is board-certified by the American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Aimee is affiliated with Mills-Peninsula Medical Center and Stanford Hospital.

Other relevant positions

Dr. Aimee is a fellow of the American College of Obstetrics and Gynecology and contributes to research in the field of reproductive endocrinology and infertility. She has presented her research at the national meetings of the American Society of Reproductive Medicine, the Endocrine Society, and the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists.

She has a weekly video series called The Egg Whisperer Show that teaches viewers about fertility, fertility care, fertility testing, and reproductive medicine.

Dr. Aimee is the mom to four children under the age of 10.

Research and publications

Dr. Aimee's research has been published in several medical journals, including Fertility and Sterility, The Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism, Obstetrics and Gynecology, and Menopause.

She has co-authored book chapters on ultrasonography and male infertility with leaders in the field of reproductive endocrinology.

Dr. Tina Feeley is a board-certified pediatrician practicing at Chestnut Hill Pediatrics in Chestnut Hill, Massachusetts.

After graduating from Boston College with a Bachelor of Science in Biology, Dr. Feeley went on to earn her Masters in Public Health from Dartmouth Medical School. She then earned an M.D. with honors from Rutgers Robert Wood Johnson Medical School in New Brunswick, New Jersey.

Dr. Feeley completed her pediatric residency at the Children's Hospital of The King's Daughters in Norfolk, Virginia. She later worked as a general pediatrician at Naval Medical Center Portsmouth, Virginia — taking care of the children of active duty service members — before moving to Boston and starting her current position at Chestnut Hill Pediatrics.

Board certifications

Dr. Feeley is board-certified by the American Board of Pediatrics and a member of the American Academy of Pediatrics.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Feeley is affiliated with Boston Children’s Hospital in Boston, Massachusetts.

Other relevant positions

Dr. Feeley previously served as an assistant professor of pediatrics, teaching Navy and Air Force pediatric residents and medical students from the Uniformed Services University of the Health Sciences in Bethesda, Maryland.

Awards

Dr. Feeley is a member of both the Alpha Omega Alpha Honor Society and the Gold Humanism Honor Society.

Dr. Rajeev Fernando is an infectious diseases specialist and an infectious diseases consultant at FEMA emergency field hospitals nationwide.

After graduating from Rajah Muttiah Medical College in India, Dr. Fernando did fellowships in infectious diseases at Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center in Hanover, New Hampshire, and at North Shore/Long Island Jewish Hospital in Long Island, New York.

Board certifications

Dr. Fernando is board-certified by the American Board of Internal Medicine, including its infectious disease division.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Fernando was formerly affiliated with Stony Brook Southampton Hospital and Eastern Long Island Hospital. He is now affiliated with FEMA emergency field hospitals.

Other relevant positions

Dr. Fernando was previously on the faculty of the Internal Medicine Residency Training Program at Southampton Hospital in New York. He has also been an assistant professor of medicine at SUNY Stony Brook. He is the past director of the Division of Infectious Diseases at Stony Brook Southampton Hospital in Stony Brook, New York.

He has served as an International Physician and on the Emergency Backup Team for Doctors Without Borders.

Dr. Fernando worked on treating babies with the Zika virus in Brazil and treated an outbreak of the Ebola virus in Sierra Leone. He is involved in getting out public health messages on the current Ebola virus outbreak at the Rwanda border and on the measles virus outbreak. He also worked on the frontlines of the COVID-19 pandemic.

Dr. Fernando is a member of the Infectious Diseases Society of America, the American Medical Association and other organizations.

Awards

Dr. Fernando has been a Castle Connolly Top Doctor since 2014. He received the 2018 Heroes of the Year award from HSBC Bank.

Hearing First is a subsidiary organization of the Oberkotter Foundation, a private foundation with a 37-year history supporting listening and spoken language (LSL) opportunities for children who are deaf or hard of hearing.

Working with a multidisciplinary team of pediatric audiologists, otologists, pediatricians, speech-language pathologists, and teachers of the deaf, Hearing First supports families and professionals to help children with hearing loss. Its mission is to ensure that children who are deaf or hard of hearing have opportunities to reach their full potential.

Hearing First uses its years of experience and expertise to connect professionals and communities with the latest evidence-based information. It makes all of its resources and learning experiences available to the public at no cost.

Learn more about Hearing First and its work supporting children who are deaf or hard of hearing at hearingfirst.org.

Jennifer Friedman is a registered dietitian who specializes in picky eating and pediatric feeding challenges. She works with parents and their children in her private practice, Jenny Friedman Nutrition.

Friedman received a Bachelor of Arts degree from McGill University in Montreal, Canada, and a Master of Science degree in nutrition from Columbia University Teachers College in New York City.

Other relevant positions

Known for her child-led approachable style, Friedman is a leading resource for parents and professionals working with children who have limited diets and eating struggles.

She is the author of Stories of Extreme Picky Eating: Children with Severe Eating Challenges and the Solutions that Helped Them.

Friedman lives with her family in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

M.D., F.A.C.O.G.

Dr. Gaither is a double-board-certified physician specializing in obstetrics/gynecology and maternal fetal medicine. She serves as the director of perinatal services and maternal fetal medicine at NYC Health+ Hospitals/Lincoln in the Bronx, New York.

Dr. Gaither received her B.A. in biology from Barnard College, and her M.D. from SUNY Health Science Center in Syracuse, New York. She did her OB/GYN residency at Riverside Regional Medical Center, a subsidiary of The Medical College of Virginia, and completed her maternal fetal medicine fellowship at The University of Medicine and Dentistry-Rutgers in Newark, New Jersey.

Dr. Gaither earned her MPH in health policy and management from Columbia University. She also has a dual MS/MBA degree in health care policy and research/health care leadership from Cornell SC Johnson School of Business.

A perinatal consultant and womens’ health expert, Dr. Gaither’s expertise is grounded in both research and in her professional experience caring for women with multiple medical or fetal conditions in pregnancy.

Board certifications

Dr. Gaither is board-certified by the American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology in both maternal fetal medicine and obstetrics and gynecology.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Gaither is affiliated with NYC Health+ Hospitals/Lincoln in the Bronx.

Other relevant positions

Dr. Gaither is an associate professor of clinical obstetrics and gynecology at Cornell Weill Medicine. She has been named a Fellow for the American Institute of Ultrasound in Medicine (AIUM).

Awards

Dr. Gaither is on the medical advisory board of NATERA, PWN Health, Organic and Natural Association, GoodRx, and SAMSUNG. She has been appointed to the Board of Directors for the United Nations Association (Southern NY State Division).

Dr. Gaither additionally serves as a liaison to The Association of Black Cardiologists, addressing cardiac disease in pregnancy. She has been recently re-appointed by New York state Rep. George Latimer to the African American Advisory Board for Westchester County.

Dr. Gaither has been named by Castle Connolly as a Top Doctor in 2023, 2024, and 2025. She holds key committee positions in the Society of Maternal Fetal Medicine (SMFM), the American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology (ABOG), and the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) related to education for both patients and physicians.

Dr. Gaither was recently appointed by New York Gov. Kathy Holchul to the New York State Maternal Health Task Force.

Dr. Oluwatosin "Tosin" Goje is a board-certified OB/GYN and infectious diseases specialist at the Cleveland Clinic's Obstetrics, Gynecology and Women's Health Institute in Cleveland, Ohio. She works in the Obstetrics and Gynecology department and Center for Specialized Women’s Health.

Dr. Goje is an expert in infectious diseases during pregnancy, including the impact of COVID-19, Zika, HIV, sexually transmitted diseases and other infections and diseases on pregnant women and their babies.

Dr. Goje received her medical degree from Ahmadu Bello University in Zaria, Kaduna, Nigeria, and earned a Master's of Science and Clinical Research at the Medical University of South Carolina in Charleston, South Carolina. She did an internship year in internal medicine at Metropolitan Hospital in New York, New York, and completed her obstetrics and gynecology residency at the University of Medicine and Dentistry of New Jersey-New Jersey Medical School, Rutgers University, in Newark, New Jersey.

Dr. Goje completed a fellowship in reproductive infectious diseases at the Medical University of South Carolina in Charleston.

Board certifications

Dr. Goje is board-certified by the American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Goje is affiliated with the Cleveland Clinic in Cleveland.

Other relevant positions

Dr. Goje is an assistant professor of obstetrics/gynecology and reproductive biology at Cleveland Clinic's Lerner College of Medicine of Case Western Reserve University.

She is a member of the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG), the Infectious Diseases Society for Obstetrics and Gynecology (IDSOG) and the Infectious Disease Society of America (IDSA).

Dr. Goje serves as a reviewer for Journal of Minimally Invasive Gynecology (JMIG), the British Medical Journal (BMJ) and other medical and academic journals. She is a regular and frequent media contributor and expert on pregnancy and infectious diseases, specifically COVID-19 and pregnancy.

Publications and research

Dr. Goje is actively involved in research and clinical trials and has published numerous papers and peer-reviewed articles on infectious diseases during pregnancy, labor and delivery, and pregnancy complications, among other topics.

Rachel Goldstein is a labor and postpartum doula, lactation counselor and childbirth educator at Postmodern Childbirth LLC in New York City, where she supports families in pregnancy, childbirth and through the newborn stage.

Her passion for helping people during such a pivotal time in their lives began when she was first pregnant in 2007. Known for her calm nature and sense of humor, Ms. Goldstein serves her clients in ways that best fits their specific needs.

Ms. Goldstein holds an M.A. in sociology from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign and a master’s in philosophy from the University of Greenwich in London, England.

She completed her doula training with both DONA International and ProDoula, and her breastfeeding counselor certification with Lea Rivera of Empire Lactation.

Other relevant positions

Ms. Goldstein is the director of the Astoria Doula Collective in Queens, New York, a member of the professional Evidence-Based Birth community, an affiliate member of the New York Lactation Consultant Association, and a member of Perinatal Connection in New York, New York.

Originally from the Midwest, Ms. Goldstein lives in Jackson Heights, Queens, in New York City with her husband and two spirited sons.

Lisa Greaves Taylor is the founder of Birth Matters NYC and has been working with New York City-area birthing families since 2010 as a childbirth educator and birth doula.

She is certified with Lamaze International, Childbirth Education Association of Metropolitan New York (CEA/MNY) and DONA International.

Ms. Greaves Taylor is devoted to helping equip birthing people with best current evidence, strategic and coping tools, and self-advocacy strategies toward safer, more empowering and positive journeys into parenthood.

She is particularly passionate about advocating for positive change in birthing and postpartum outcomes for Black, BIPOC, LGBTQ+, and underserved or marginalized populations.

Other relevant positions

Ms. Greaves Taylor served on CEA/MNY's board of directors for five years. She's also an Evidence Based Birth instructor and a certified lactation support counselor.

During the pandemic, she stepped into the role of owner/director of Astoria Doula Collective with the goal of providing a more comprehensive offering of support to birthing families.

In 2018, she created the Birth Matters COMPLETE COURSE (an online, self-paced childbirth class) and then in 2019, she created and launched the BIRTH MATTERS podcast, which shares mostly New York City-based birth and fertility journey stories along with childbirth education commentary.

Awards

Ms. Greaves Taylor received the Childbirth Education Association's Ellen Chuse Childbirth Educator of the Year award in 2017.

Dr. James Greenberg is a board-certified general obstetrician/gynecologist and serves as a Vice Chairman of the Department of Obstetrics & Gynecology at Brigham and Women's Hospital in Boston, Massachusetts.

Dr. Greenberg did his residency training at the Brigham and Women's Hospital and Massachusetts General Hospital in Boston, Massachusetts.

He has a Bachelor of Arts degree in history from Amherst College and received his M.D. from New York University School of Medicine.

Board certification

Dr. Greenberg is board-certified by the American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Greenberg is affiliated with Brigham and Women's Hospital and Brigham and Women's Faulkner Hospital in Boston.

Other relevant positions

Dr. Greenberg is an associate professor of Obstetrics and Gynecology at Harvard Medical School and a team member of the International Organization for Women and Development (IOWD), which addresses women's health issues in Rwanda.

Publications and research

Dr. Greenberg has published more than 100 articles, abstracts and chapters in a wide variety of scientific media. He is a subject author for UpToDate on C-sections and vaginal deliveries requiring vacuum extraction.

Awards

Dr. Greenberg has been a Castle Connolly Top Doctor since 2010.

Ruchi Gupta, M.D., M.P.H., has 17 years of experience as a board-certified pediatrician and health researcher and serves as the founding director of the Center for Food Allergy & Asthma Research (CFAAR) at Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine and Ann & Robert H. Lurie Children’s Hospital of Chicago.

She completed her undergraduate and medical education at the University of Louisville and completed her medical residency at Children’s Hospital & Regional Medical Center, University of Washington in Seattle. She also completed her pediatric health services research fellowship at Boston Children’s Hospital and Harvard Medical School, and went on to receive her Master of Public Health from the Harvard School of Public Health.

Dr. Gupta is world-renowned for her groundbreaking research in food allergy and asthma epidemiology, most notably for her research on the prevalence of pediatric and adult food allergy in the United States. She has also significantly contributed to academic research in the areas of food allergy prevention, socioeconomic disparities in care and the daily management of these conditions. To reduce the burden of these conditions and improve health equity, she and her team develop, evaluate and disseminate interventions for families and conduct work to inform local, national and international health policy.

Board certification

Dr. Gupta is board certified by the American Board of Pediatrics.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Gupta is affiliated with Ann & Robert H. Lurie Children’s Hospital of Chicago.

Other relevant positions

Dr. Gupta is a professor of pediatrics and medicine at Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine and founding director of the Center for Food Allergy & Asthma Research (CFAAR). Dr. Gupta also serves as Chief Medical Officer for Public Health for Food Allergy Research & Education. She belongs to many professional organizations, including: Women in Bio (WIB), Psychosocial Aspects of Allergy Committee (WAO), Professional Membership for the Association of Asthma Educators, European Academy of Allergy and Clinical Immunology (EAACI) and American Association of Physicians of Indian Origin (AAPI). Dr. Gupta is a fellow of the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP); American College of Allergy, Asthma, and Immunology (ACAAI); and American Academy of Allergy Asthma and Immunology (AAAAI).

Publications and research

Dr. Gupta is the author of the Food Allergy Experience and Food Without Fear, has written and co-authored over 150 peer-reviewed research manuscripts, and has had her work featured on major TV networks and in print media.

Awards

Dr. Gupta has received numerous awards, including

Equalize Pitch Competition – Overall Winner in Therapeutics 2021

Women in Bio Pitch Challenge – Audience Favorite 2020

Canadian Society of Allergy and Clinical Immunology (CSACI) Bram Rose Memorial Lectureship Award 2020

Food Allergy Research and Educations 20th Annual Food Allergy Ball "20 for 20" Award 2018

Slaton graduated from the University of Florida with a degree in journalism.

Other relevant positions

Aside from being a C.P.S.T., Slaton has been writing about parenting, pregnancy, baby products and women's health since 2004. She is a member of Safe Kids Worldwide.

Dr. Shannon Smith is a board-certified OB/GYN and partner at Brigham Faulkner Ob/Gyn Associates in Boston, Massachusetts.

Dr. Smith has a B.A. degree in psychology with a distinction of honors from Wake Forest University. She earned her M.D. from Wake Forest University School of Medicine and completed her residency and training at Tufts Medical Center in Boston.

Board certifications

Dr. Smith is board-certified by the American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Smith is affiliated with Brigham and Women’s Hospital and Brigham and Women’s Faulkner Hospital in Boston.

Other relevant positions

Dr. Smith is a faculty member at Harvard Medical School and a fellow of the American Congress of Obstetricians & Gynecologists (FACOG). She's also a member of the American College of Obstetrics & Gynecology (ACOG), the American Medical Association (AMA), the Massachusetts Medical Association (MMS) and the American Association of Gynecologic Laparoscopists (AAGL).

Publications

Dr. Smith has published a variety of abstracts and online articles covering subjects related to pregnancy and minimally invasive surgery.

Awards

Dr. Smith has been honored as a Top Doctor in Massachusetts since 2015.

Dr. Aaron K. Styer is a founding partner and medical director of Colorado Center for Reproductive Medicine (CCRM) Boston in Newton, Massachusetts. A reproductive endocrinologist, he is board-certified in obstetrics and gynecology, as well as its sub-specialty reproductive endocrinology and infertility.

Dr. Styer received his medical degree from Vanderbilt University School of Medicine and his undergraduate degree from Duke University. He completed his residency in the Harvard Integrated Program in Obstetrics and Gynecology at Brigham and Women’s Hospital and Massachusetts General Hospital (MGH), where he later practiced for a number of years. He did his clinical fellowship in Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility at MGH/Harvard Medical School.

Board certifications

Dr. Styer is board-certified by the American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Styer is affiliated with Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center in Boston and Newton Wellesley Hospital in Newton.

Other relevant positions

Dr. Styer is an associate professor of Obstetrics, Gynecology, and Reproductive Biology at Harvard Medical School.

Passionate about patient education, advocacy, and expanded access to fertility care, Dr. Styer is an active member of the American Society for Reproductive Medicine (ASRM), the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG), and the Society for Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility (SREI).

He serves on the board of directors for the national infertility advocacy organizations All Paths Family Building and Fertility Within Reach, and is a member of the medical advisory board for Progyny.

Awards

Dr. Styer has been honored by his peers annually as a Boston Magazine Best of Boston Top Doctor and a Castle Connolly Top Doctor from 2018 through 2024.

He is committed to the continued advancement of transformative access and patient-centered care in fertility medicine, and to the continued empowerment of patients and couples during their family-building journeys.

Dr. Eric Surrey is a board-certified reproductive endocrinologist and fertility specialist who practices at the Colorado Center for Reproductive Medicine (CCRM) in Lone Tree, Colorado.

Dr. Surrey completed his residency and fellowship training in the Department of OB/GYN at the UCLA School of Medicine in Los Angeles, California.

Board certifications

Dr. Surrey is board-certified by the American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Surrey is affiliated with Sky Ridge Medical Center in Lone Tree, Colorado.

Other relevant positions

Prior to joining CCRM in 1999, Dr. Surrey was an associate clinical professor of OB/GYN at UCLA and had been director of the Division of Reproductive Medicine at Cedars-Sinai Medical Center and the Assisted Reproductive Technologies Program at Century City Hospital in Los Angeles.

He is past president of the Society for Assisted Reproductive Technology, Society of Reproductive Surgeons and the Pacific Coast Reproductive Society, and currently serves on the Executive Council of the Society for Assisted Reproductive Technology.

Dr. Surrey has authored more than 125 peer-reviewed articles and invited publications, and he has presented on more than 135 abstracts at national and international meetings on the subjects of infertility, endometriosis and assisted reproductive technologies.

Awards

Dr. Surrey has been named a Castle Connolly Top Doctor in Reproductive Endocrinology in 2017 and 2018 and was also selected as one of America’s Top Doctors for Women by Women’s Health Magazine in November 2008.

Phyliss Nicole Taylor, M.D., PMH-C, is a board-certified general psychiatrist with a certification in perinatal mental health and a member of the What to Expect Medical Review Board. She manages a wide range of mental health disorders including depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, post-traumatic stress disorder, and psychotic disorders.

Experience

Dr. Taylor is employed at the outpatient mental health clinic at North Florida/South Georgia Veterans Health Administration in Jacksonville, Florida. She is also a courtesy assistant professor at the University of Florida – Jacksonville and supervises psychiatry residents in training.

Dr. Taylor has worked in a variety of mental health settings including outpatient clinics, inpatient hospitals, academic settings, nursing homes, and private practice.

In addition to her clinical practice, she is a member of the board of directors and chair of the membership and professional outreach committees for Postpartum Support International. Dr. Taylor is passionate about erasing the stigma of mental illness through community education and mental health advocacy.

Education

Dr. Taylor completed her medical degree at Meharry Medical College in Nashville, Tennessee, and her psychiatry residency at East Carolina University Brody School of Medicine in Greenville, North Carolina. She received her perinatal mental health certification from Postpartum Support International.

M.D., M.S.C.I., F.A.C.O.G.

Dr. Lorene Temming is a board-certified OB/GYN and maternal fetal medicine specialist working at Atrium Health Carolinas Medical Center Women's Institute in Charlotte, North Carolina.

Dr. Temming received her medical degree from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and completed a residency at Atrium Health Carolinas Medical Center. She completed her maternal fetal medicine fellowship at Washington University in St. Louis, where she also earned a Master of Science in Clinical Investigation.

Board certifications

Dr. Temming is board-certified by the American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology in both Obstetrics and Gynecology and Maternal-Fetal Medicine.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Temming is the medical director of Labor and Delivery at Atrium Health Carolinas Medical Center in Charlotte, North Carolina.

Other relevant positions

Dr. Temming is also adjunct faculty of the Wake Forest School of Medicine and the UNC School of Medicine.

She is engaged throughout Atrium Health in advancing obstetric care through clinical protocols, research, and quality improvement in labor and delivery. Dr. Temming specializes in preterm birth prevention, infectious diseases, cervical insufficiency, fetal loss, recurrent pregnancy losses, birth traumas, pregnancies after infertility, gestational diabetes, maternal hypertensive disorders and LGBTQIA+ pregnancy care.

She suffered multiple losses, infertility and a high-risk pregnancy on her journey to parenthood, and she is especially interested in supporting others along their journeys.

Dr. Temming loves spending time outside of work with her husband and their child. Her hobbies include traveling, reading and musical theater.

Publications and research

Dr. Temming’s research has been published in JAMA Pediatrics, Obstetrics & Gynecology and the American Journal of Obstetrics & Gynecology, among others. She received a Society of Maternal Fetal Medicine Health Policy grant, and the subsequent research won the Society of Maternal Fetal Medicine Disparities Award for best research on disparities in health outcomes.

Awards

Dr. Temming has received several additional awards, including Top Doctor by Charlotte magazine and SouthPark magazine, the Most Innovative Quality Improvement Research Award and the Resident Education Award from the Atrium Health Center for Faculty Excellence, and the Excellence in Teaching Award from the UNC Academy of Educators. Additionally, she was a nominee for the Atrium Health Physician Advanced Practice Provider Leader of the Year Award.

Sarah White is a certified speech-language pathologist and co-owner of Speakology LLC, a practice located in the Farmington Valley region of Connecticut. She also has extensive training with feeding and swallowing disorders, tethered oral tissues and apraxia. White has experience working in therapy clinics as well as private accredited special education school programs across the state of Connecticut.

White earned both her Bachelor of Arts in Communication Disorders and her Master of Arts in Speech Language Pathology from the University of Connecticut in Storrs, Connecticut.

Board certifications

White is a member of the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association and maintains her Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC). She also holds her Department of Public Health License from the state of Connecticut.

Other relevant positions

White is a Level 2 PROMPT trained speech-language pathologist, with additional trainings in the Kaufman Speech to Language Protocol, Dynamic Temporal and Tactile Cueing (DTTC), Beckman Oral Motor Protocol, Oral Placement Therapy, LSVT Loud, LAMP and Social Thinking (Michelle Garcia Winner). She is also trained in the Lindamood Bell Talkies® Program for Oral Language Comprehension & Expression as well as the Nancibell® Visualizing and Verbalizing® Program for Cognitive Development, Comprehension & Thinking.

In addition, White is an orofacial myofunctional therapist with training from the International Association of Orofacial Myology (IAOM) for the study and treatment of the oral and facial muscles.

Dr. Jessica Wu is a board-certified dermatologist in private practice in Los Angeles, California.

She received her medical degree from Harvard Medical School and completed her dermatology training at the University of Southern California (USC) Keck School of Medicine.

Board certifications

Dr. Wu is board-certified by the American Board of Dermatology.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Wu is affiliated with Keck Hospital of USC in Glendale, California.

Other relevant positions

In addition to Dr. Wu's private practice, she teaches at USC as an assistant clinical professor of dermatology at the USC Keck School of Medicine. Dr. Wu also frequently lectures at national and international medical conferences.

She is a member of the American Academy of Dermatology, American Society for Dermatologic Surgery, and the Medical Council of the American Society for Nutrition.

Dr. Wu has conducted research studies of skin care products and devices, and was an investigator in the clinical trials that led to Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval of Juvederm wrinkle filler and Latisse lash growth serum.

Dr. Wu's best-selling book, Feed Your Face: Younger, Smoother Skin and a Beautiful Body in 28 Delicious Days, has earned her many fans who follow her holistic approach to health and beauty. It has also been published in the U.K., China, Russia, Taiwan and India.

Dr. Wu has appeared on Good Morning America and CNN, been featured in The New York Times, People and The Wall Street Journal, and is a regular contributor to BuzzFeed.

In her free time, Dr Wu enjoys fitness activities and is a certified ski instructor. She lives in Los Angeles with her husband.

M.D., F.A.C.O.G.

Dr. Jennifer Leighdon Wu is a board-certified obstetrician/gynecologist with her own private practice, Women's Health of Manhattan, in New York City.

Dr. Wu completed her residency in Obstetrics and Gynecology at Lenox Hill Hospital in New York, New York.

She has a Bachelor of Arts in Romance Languages and Literature from Harvard University and an M.D. from the Medical University of South Carolina in Charleston.

Board certification

Dr. Wu is board-certified by the American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology.

Hospital affiliations

Dr. Wu is affiliated with Lenox Hill Hospital in New York City.

Other relevant positions

Dr. Wu is a member of the American Medical Association and the New York County Medical Society.

She is the mother of two sons.

Awards

Dr. Wu has been a Castle Connolly Top Doctor from 2017 to the present. She was also selected as one of the 2020 Super Doctors.

Dr. Kelley Yost Abrams is a family and childhood therapist, an early childhood researcher, and a consultant specializing in parent-child relationships, social-emotional development, and infant mental health.

Dr. Yost Abrams received her Ph.D. in developmental psychology at the University of California, Berkeley.

Experience

Dr. Yost Abrams leads operations at Jigsaw Diagnostics, a telehealth provider of early autism and other neurobehavioral evaluations. She provides expertise to leading pediatric organizations and has been at the forefront of digital therapeutics.

Dr. Yost Abrams founded a company called Child Development and Parenting Consultations, and offers therapy services to parents at Maven Clinic, which provides online therapy services and is based in New York City.

She has served families with a diverse range of needs, including those with premature infants and parents of children with behavioral difficulties, developmental delays, disabilities, giftedness, autism spectrum disorder, anxiety and ADHD.

Other relevant positions

Dr. Yost Abrams is a fellow with Zero to Three, a parenting website, and a member of the advisory board of Greenlightfund.org. She is also the mother of two teens.

Meet the What to Expect Editorial Team

Melissa Bykofsky is the executive editor of strategy & growth at What to Expect. Bykofsky has more than a decade of experience working as a health and lifestyle journalist and editor. She lives in New York City with her toddler and husband.

Experience

Before joining the What to Expect team in 2023, Bykofsky was editorial director at Parents and was on staff there for five years. She also worked at Woman's Day, Redbook and Marie Claire. Bykofsky is also a journalism instructor at her alma mater, Binghamton University.

Education

Bykofsky graduated magna cum laude with a Bachelor of Arts degree in English literature from Binghamton University. Bykofsky earned her Master's in journalism from Craig Newmark Graduate School of Journalism at CUNY.

Catherine Donaldson-Evans is the managing editor of content operations at What to Expect, the most trusted pregnancy and parenting brand. She is an expert in health, pregnancy and parenting. Her other specialties include entertainment, news and lifestyle.

Experience

In addition to What to Expect, where she's also been a health, essay and news writer, Donaldson-Evans has worked at numerous publications, including CafeMom, Parents, FitPregnancy, SheKnows, Mom365, New Jersey Family, Prevention, People, Life & Style Weekly, InTouch Weekly, Fox News and the New York Daily News, among others.

Education

Donaldson-Evans has an M.A. in journalism from New York University and a B.A. in communications and English from the University of Pennsylvania.

Awards and Notable Accreditation

Donaldson-Evans is a recipient of many awards, including:

Society of Professional Journalists awards for news & feature writing

Keystone Press awards for investigative reporting and special subject writing

Award for commitment to the homeless from the People's Emergency Center, a homeless shelter for moms and kids in Philadelphia

Her philanthropic work has included serving as a longtime Save the Children sponsor, a board member of the Enterprise Foundation Gotham Society in New York City, and a volunteer with New York Cares. She is also a past member of the New York Press Club.

Outside of work, Donaldson-Evans enjoys spending time with her husband and two children (a daughter and a son), reading, writing, traveling, volunteering and yoga.

Caroline Picard is the deputy editor at What to Expect, the most trusted pregnancy and parenting brand. Picard has more than a decade of experience working as a health and lifestyle journalist. She lives in Boston with her husband, baby boy, and rescue dog. Outside of work, you'll find her baking, doing crosswords, or running along the Emerald Necklace.

Experience

Prior to joining the What to Expect team, Picard worked at Philadelphia magazine, Boston magazine, Good Housekeeping, House Beautiful, and other publications covering pregnancy, parenting, health, and other lifestyle topics.

Education

Picard graduated magna cum laude with a Bachelor of Science degree from the Medill School of Journalism at Northwestern University.

Olivia DeLong is the senior health editor at What to Expect, the most trusted pregnancy and parenting brand. DeLong has a passion for women's and children's health, thanks to her own fertility experiences and journey to parenthood.

DeLong lives in Atlanta with her husband, young daughter, and yellow Lab.

Experience

Prior to joining What to Expect, DeLong worked as an editor at Sharecare.com and WomansDay.com, and as a freelancer for various websites, including CHOA.org and SpineUniverse.com. She has more than 12 years of experience writing and editing in the health space, especially on women’s health, children's health, mental health, and sleep.

Education

DeLong has a bachelor's degree in creative writing from Florida State University. She's also a member of the Association of Health Care Journalists

Jamison Hermann is senior video producer at What to Expect, the most trusted pregnancy and parenting brand. He supervises the creation and distribution of all new and existing video content by What to Expect.

In past roles, Hermann has worked in documentary filmmaking, advertising and editorial video production, including a stint as a video producer for Parents magazine. He has a bachelor’s degree in film studies from Connecticut College.

Hermann lives in New York City with his wife and young daughter. Outside of work, he enjoys traveling, bicycling and spending time on the water in wooden boats.

Sarah Saelee is an assistant social media editor at What to Expect, the most trusted pregnancy and parenting brand. In her current role, Saelee helps in the management of the brand’s social media accounts, including Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Pinterest and TikTok.

She lives in the San Francisco Bay Area with her husband. In her spare time, she enjoys traveling, skiing, golf, hiking and photography.

Experience

Saelee has a background in social media management for both large corporations and smaller companies. She also has more than a decade of experience in child care and early childhood education.

Education

Saelee has a bachelor’s degree in advertising from The Art Institutes of California.

Bre’Anna Grant is an associate social media producer at What to Expect, the most trusted pregnancy and parenting brand. In her current role, she is responsible for producing and editing video content published on the brand’s TikTok, Instagram and Facebook platforms. Grant also manages community engagement for What to Expect's TikTok account.

Based in New York (but always on the go), Grant has called many amazing cities home over the years. In her free time, she enjoys traveling, reading and painting.

Experience

Previously, Grant worked at Thrillist, where she was an associate video producer and editor who pitched, produced and edited food and travel videos for TikTok and Snapchat. She also created Instagram content highlighting new restaurants and offering travel tips.

Education

Bre’Anna has a bachelor’s degree in journalism from St. John’s University in New York City.
